findings.claim: Original retail terrain and WRLD initialization install authenticated M06 scale, properties and every runtime page pointer without a synthetic terrain grid.
findings.limitations: Original Ghidra instruction execution with explicit OS/CRT/file-resource and peripheral WRLD services. One mission; not full WinMain or resource-device initialization.

findings.claim: 00493550 is a bilinear X/Z-to-height sampler; localized hardware FISTP correction is required for the measured Ghidra fractional-coordinate and page-seam results to match retail instructions.
findings.limitations: Hardware instruction oracle covers FISTP/FCOS only; remaining sampler runs under Ghidra. No full original sampler-on-hardware or general x87 parity claim. Normal and material paths have distinct semantics.

findings.claim: Restoring original 0049E0F0 filter initialization, delegating only FCOS, allows original 0049E1B0/0046DC10 to produce finite nonzero contact-mode compression within native tire limits.
findings.limitations: Tested stock bus/GTSi in controlled replay, not calibrated physical dynamics or Windows input/scheduling. Prior whole-function cosine stub is retained only as a diagnostic observation.

findings.claim: After original engsnd.dat registry startup and native component selection, both vehicles complete 32 original physics callbacks with validated terrain and contact-mode tire updates; four slower frames execute twelve solver substeps.
findings.limitations: Explicit emulation/service and instruction boundaries, controlled spawn pose, drive/camera/pause and GetTickCount. No positive 00440740 special four-point probe return; no complete mission scheduler, full cockpit/weapon initialization or object/intersection collisions.

findings.claim: The ownership/consumer bridge between scene list 00644200 and polygon-surface candidates 0052B94C remains unverified; validated heightfield contact does not establish road/intersection GEO collision behavior.
findings.limitations: Current replay does not populate or test a real intersection polygon-surface collision fixture.
